headline: Apple and LG reportedly building smart home lineup ahead of October 13 event
summary: Apple is reportedly partnering with LG on smart home devices including a lock, doorbell, thermostat and camera, according to a Bloomberg report. Apple has announced an October 13 'Welcome home' event in New York, widely expected to unveil these products. Leaked images reportedly show a lock, thermostat and temperature sensor among the devices.
